sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Early Chapter · lived · Metal, Expression, release
sections.text: Your Early Chapter carried Metal, the energy of Expression, into a chart that had plenty to say already. As a child you talked back, tested every rule and wanted everything at once. A craft or a stage gave the noise a shape, and you left school knowing where your talent lay.

sections.head: UNDERNEATH
sections.sub: The Early Chapter · lived · Metal, Expression, release
sections.text: Under it ran Earth, which fed the Metal, and you felt it hold all the way through.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Earth, a strength your chart was short of, with games and teams at school. You learned early that you could hold your own among other children.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Earth through brothers, sisters or cousins close in age. You learned to stand up for your share at the family table, and you never quite stopped.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Rising Chapter · lived · Metal, Expression, release
sections.text: Your Rising Chapter carried Metal, the energy of Expression, to a chart already loud with it. Between your late teens and mid-thirties you spoke first, spent freely and chafed at every rule you had not written. Your best work came from the craft that held you still, and you left those years with a talent sharpened by friction.

sections.head: UNDERNEATH
sections.sub: The Rising Chapter · lived · Metal, Expression, release
sections.text: Under it ran Wood, which the Metal held down, and you put both to work.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Fire through study, a course or a training that finally fitted. You gained a way of thinking that you still use.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Home Chapter · now · Metal, Expression, release
sections.text: Your Home Chapter carries Metal, the energy of Expression, and your chart cannot use all of it. Since your mid-thirties appetite and opinion have filled the house, and a partner has borne the brunt of your restlessness. Making something with your hands each week settles it, and you are learning to let a partner have the last word.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Love, this chapter favours hearing a partner out over making your point, and you win more warmth by asking than by telling.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Career, this chapter favours a clear brief over a free hand, and you do your finest work inside limits someone else has set.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: At home, this chapter favours a kind word over a sharp one, and you keep the household calm by holding back the first reply.

sections.head: WORKING WITH IT
sections.text: This chapter loosens your tongue past what your chart can carry. A craft that takes patience spends it well, and you keep your standing when your talent speaks for you.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Fire, the Mind your chart has gone without, with study and people who look out for you. A mentor or a course opens a door you had walked past. You learn faster than you expected, and you rest without guilt for the first time in years.

sections.head: DECADE · UNDERNEATH

sections.text: Your Late Chapter carries Fire, the energy of Mind, and your chart opens to it. From your late forties there is time at last to learn for pleasure, and the people after you come to you for advice. You become the one others think things through with.

sections.head: UNDERNEATH

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: At home, this chapter favours a quiet household over a busy one, and you find the shelter you have wanted for a long time.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Health, this chapter favours early nights over late ones, and you gather strength from long sleeps and slow mornings.

sections.text: Your Home Chapter carries Wood, your own energy, though your chart already holds plenty of it. From your mid-thirties two strong wills share one household, and a partner who feels like an equal also feels like a contest. You find your footing through work you do side by side, and you win more at home by giving way.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Love, this chapter favours a partner with a strong will of their own over one who agrees, and you soften once you meet your match.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: At home, this chapter favours giving ground over holding it, and you keep the peace by letting someone else be right.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: With friends, this chapter favours teamwork over rivalry, and you get more from a circle once you no longer need to win each round.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Wood beyond what your chart needs, and it sets you against people who want the same prize. Making something with your hands or your voice carries you, and you spend the surplus where it shows.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Late Chapter · coming · Water, Mind, release
sections.text: Your Late Chapter carries Water, the energy of Mind, and your chart is already well stocked with it. From your late forties the people after you fuss over you more than you need, and quiet days pile up. Teaching what you know turns that stillness into use, and you stay sharper for it.

sections.head: UNDERNEATH
sections.sub: The Late Chapter · coming · Water, Mind, release
sections.text: Under it runs Metal, which feeds the Water, and you feel it hold all the way through.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: At home, this chapter favours looking after others over being looked after, and you gain strength from the jobs you take off someone's hands.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Career, this chapter favours doing the work over preparing for it, and you discover that you already know enough to begin.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Growth, this chapter favours practice over theory, and you learn more from one real attempt than from a shelf of advice.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Wood again, with a habit of holding on to your own way at home. A partner who stands as your equal bears you up, and you find that yielding costs less than it seems.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Water and more advice than you can use, from people who mean well. Hands-on work and plain targets carry you, and you trust your own reading of things.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Water again, with endless reading and plans that stall before they start. A practical partner or a deadline keeps you moving, and you finish more than you begin.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Fire brings Expression for a whole year, the outlet your chart holds and still enjoys. What you make and say lands well, and you take real pleasure in your own talent.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: You tie yourself to a workplace or a team this year more firmly than before, by contract or by loyalty.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Fire brings Expression for a second year running, the outlet your chart still enjoys. A skill you used for pleasure starts to pay, and you make more than you planned.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Earth brings Action for a whole year, the chase your chart cannot keep up with. There is more to manage than hours to manage it, and you get through on your own steady strength and a short list.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: You change something at home this year, an address or the way you share your life with a partner.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Earth brings Action for a second year running, more demands than your chart can meet. The list keeps growing after last year, and you get through by dropping what does not matter.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: You go back over something from your first home this year, an old habit or an old grievance you thought was settled.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Metal brings Order for a whole year, the energy you need most. It presses on you from outside, and you end the year harder to bend.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: You come under scrutiny at work this year, a review or a rule applied to you more strictly than to others.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Metal brings Order for a second year running, the shape your chart lacks. The role you took on last year settles into place, and people start to rely on your word.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: Someone you have trained or helped along pulls back without a word this year, and you notice the distance before it hardens.

sections.text: Your Rising Chapter carried Wood, the energy of Expression, and your chart came alive with it. From your late teens to your mid-thirties you made things, spoke up and found friends who liked what you made. You came out of that chapter with a voice people recognised.

From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household was soft and settled, and you thought over every choice twice. A practical project shared with a partner got you out of your head, and you left knowing that thinking needs a deadline.

sections.text: Your Late Chapter carries Metal, the energy of Mind, and your chart holds more than it can use. Since your late forties you have been looked after and advised from every side, and what you built runs without much from you. Passing on what you know gives the stillness a purpose, and you find a role beyond being cared for.
